verdict.rationale: Simular's core product is its built-in assistant Sai. You describe work in plain English and Sai carries it out on a cloud computer or your own device, across desktop apps, browsers, files and terminals. It keeps working after you close the laptop, asks for approval before sensitive steps, and can save workflows as replayable, scheduled skills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, since all evidence is first-party.
